data.name: Bar Color Changes for Lockpicking Interface
data.desc:
Changes both positive bars in the lockpicking minigame to light green and the negative bar to a brighter red. Made for my friend [@ran_out_of_names](https://modworkshop.net/user/219429), who said he had trouble distinguishing the dark green positive bars with the dark red negative bar. Changes to the red bar were requested by [@maazky145](https://modworkshop.net/user/maazky)

~~The second version changes the large positive bars to light blue, small positive bars to magenta, and the negative bars to orange. Requested by [@Akira](https://modworkshop.net/user/189409)~~ currently dont have this for UE5, but I will remake it eventually

Special thanks to [@pinki_ninja](https://modworkshop.net/user/pinki_ninja) for explaining how to make the changes, I probably wouldn't have been able to figure it out otherwise

data.name: PDTH Inspired Heister Portraits | Unmasked, Old Hox + Invisible Down Counter Arrows Icon
data.desc:
*Some say masks are for pussies, but even they gotta admit, masks do look cool.*
-----
***This is a customized portrait mod made to my own liking, including shots of various other mods:***

[{red}(Live-Action Masks)](https://modworkshop.net/mod/49681)
[{cyan}(PD2 Styled Clover's Mask)](https://modworkshop.net/mod/49664)
[{limegreen}(Altered Pearl Mask)](https://modworkshop.net/mod/50020)
[{limegreen}(Pearl Necklace and Scarf Restoration)](https://modworkshop.net/mod/50019)
[{hotpink}(Altered Richard Rising)](https://modworkshop.net/mod/50982)
[{dodgerblue}(Altered Joy)](https://modworkshop.net/mod/50043) [{red}(Mask Display)](https://modworkshop.net/mod/50043)
[{brown}(PAYDAY: The Heist Outfits)](https://modworkshop.net/mod/49357) by @columbus
[{red}(Bald Wolf)](https://modworkshop.net/mod/49396) by @agojyt

Fully compatible with {orange}(ZF Dynamic Portraits) | You can download the portrait mod [{orange}(here.)](https://modworkshop.net/mod/58808)
-----
Make sure to keep the mod loading at a higher priority than the ZF Dynamic Portraits mod, otherwise my heister portraits won't get through.

**{lime}(BONUS:)** The down counter arrow icon is no longer in the way of the portraits, but if you still want it out of there, I offer you the files which make the down counter arrow icon go **poof**.

-----
Mods used in the previews:
[No Color Grading UE5](https://modworkshop.net/mod/58752) by @shiruba

-----
{lime}(INSTALLATION:) Make sure your game is [modded](https://modworkshop.net/mod/47771) beforehand to allow loading in mods, then extract the downloaded files right here -> \PAYDAY3\PAYDAY3\Content\Paks\~mods
-----
⚠️{magenta}(Hoxton:) {yellow}(")It's not working lass.{yellow}(")⚠️
-----
If the mod is **not working**, make sure you've modified your game properly to allow mods to be loaded. If it's still not working, make sure you don't have any conflicting mods, you can also give my mods a higher loading priority over other mods, like adding the **a** letter prefix to each mod file.

-----
{lime}(Extra tip:) If your game renders some textures properly while other ones look like garbage, add **-dx11** to your launch options, see how that works.

data.name: Bodypillow lootbag Master
data.desc:
this is a Master mod for bodypillow loot bags it is required to make other bodypillow mods work as they should, on its own this mod only replaces the lootbags models and puts template texture on them


why this exist? pretty simple... the old models looked ass and when they were carried they were stiff,  this is what this mod aims to "fix" the bags when thrown on the ground  have swaying corners, and when they are carried they have proper weight paints done so they wont be stiff as they were in old mod, also this exists so that people can make mods easier way...


guide on how to make your own bodypillow mod compatible with this and how to install these mods to make them work properly is **[here](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1pK1TWmt1o8pVgiIHjfLdYKoUDyjupPvkequBOvXaogM/edit?usp=sharing)**
